title: Royce Nightly drops a trap pop single "Candy Crush"
htmlContent:
Royce Nightly is a rapper, singer and songwriter based in US. He recently drops his second single called "Candy Crush," a follow up of his latest singles "One Right Now," and "Beauty in the bed." The single Candy Crush is truly a superb record from the vocal performance, the lyrics, and the production that makes one special body of work with every listen.

Stream here:
excerpt: Royce Nightly is back with a fresh trap pop single, "Candy Crush". The track delivers a catchy, vibrant energy with playful beats and infectious melodies, much like the whimsical cover art. With its bold sound and upbeat vibe, "Candy Crush" is set to captivate listeners and bring an extra dose of fun to the music scene.
